maintained_by: OpenEndo agents (Jaeger + Percival) — curated, sourced, confidence-tagged. Never edit without a source.

disclaimer.en: OpenEndo access data is curated from public sources with per-entry confidence and verified dates. It is NOT medical advice. Reimbursement, availability and prices change — always verify with the pharmacy, your doctor, or the linked official sources before acting. Entries without a confidence tag are unverified placeholders.
disclaimer.da: OpenEndos adgangsdata er kurateret fra offentlige kilder med konfidens- og verifikationsdato pr. opslag. Det er IKKE lægefaglig rådgivning. Tilskud, tilgængelighed og priser ændrer sig — verificér altid hos apoteket, din læge eller de linkede officielle kilder, før du handler.

approval_note.en: EU central procedure, endometriosis indication Nov 2023

access_note.en: General reimbursement (generelt tilskud) — automatic at the pharmacy for the endometriosis indication.
access_note.da: Generelt tilskud — automatisk på apoteket til endometriose-indikationen.

approval_note.en: EU central procedure — endometriosis indication Dec 2024 (200 mg + add-back)
approval_note.da: EU-central procedure — endometriose-indikation dec. 2024 (200 mg + add-back)

access_note.en: Authorised in Denmark, but NO general reimbursement for endometriosis (fibroid-only clause). Out-of-pocket at the pharmacy unless the region grants individual reimbursement (enkelttilskud) on application.
access_note.da: Godkendt i Danmark, men INTET generelt tilskud til endometriose (kun fibrom-klausul). Betales selv på apoteket, medmindre regionen giver enkelttilskud efter ansøgning.

price_note.en: Danish list price confidential; UK ~£1,100/year (NICE). Ask pharmacy.
price_note.da: Dansk listepris fortrolig; UK ~£1.100/år (NICE). Spørg apoteket.

medications.name: First-line hormonal + pain treatment
medications.class: Combined oral contraceptive · hormonal IUD / progestin · NSAID + paracetamol

access_note.en: Continuous combined pill, hormonal IUD or progestin, plus NSAID/paracetamol — first-line per Danish guidance (Lægehåndbogen). Reimbursement follows the normal per-product rules; many products carry general reimbursement.
access_note.da: Kontinuerlig kombinations-p-pille, hormonspiral eller gestagen samt NSAID/paracetamol — førstelinje jf. Lægehåndbogen. Tilskud følger de almindelige regler pr. produkt; mange produkter har generelt tilskud.

access_note.en: Used for severe disease, max ~6 months, with add-back (estrogen/progestin) to reduce side effects. Hospital/specialist setting.
access_note.da: Anvendes ved svær sygdom, maks. ~6 mdr., med add-back (østrogen/gestagen) mod bivirkninger. Hospitals-/specialistområdet.

note.en: One of two Danish highly specialised centres for severe/advanced endometriosis — multidisciplinary team, laparoscopic + robot-assisted surgery, incl. deep infiltrating endometriosis (bowel/bladder). Referral from GP or gynecologist.
note.da: Et af Danmarks to højt specialiserede centre for svær/fremskreden endometriose — tværfagligt team, kikkert- og robotkirurgi, inkl. dyb infiltrerende endometriose (tarm/blære). Henvisning fra egen læge eller gynækolog.

name.en: Aarhus University Hospital, Skejby — Clinic for Women's Diseases (Endometriosis team)
name.da: Aarhus Universitetshospital, Skejby — Klinik for Kvindesygdomme (Endometriose-teamet)

note.en: One of two Danish highly specialised centres for severe/advanced endometriosis — multidisciplinary team (4 specialised nurses, 4 senior doctors), high volume, works with urology/gastro/plastic surgery for complex cases.
note.da: Et af Danmarks to højt specialiserede centre for svær/fremskreden endometriose — tværfagligt team (4 specialesygeplejersker, 4 overlæger), stort patientvolumen, samarbejde med urinvejs-/mave-tarm-/plastikkirurgi ved komplekse tilfælde.

note.en: Mild/moderate endometriosis is managed by your GP or a gynecologist (private practice or hospital out-patient clinic): first-line hormones + pain relief. Persistent pain despite treatment → referral to a gynaecological department. Suspected deep/advanced disease → referral to one of the two specialised centres. Free hospital choice (frit sygehusvalg) applies — your postcode does not restrict access.
note.da: Let/moderat endometriose håndteres af egen læge eller gynækolog (privatpraksis eller hospitalsambulatorium): førstelinje-hormoner + smertelindring. Vedvarende smerter trods behandling → henvisning til gynækologisk afdeling. Mistanke om dyb/fremskreden sygdom → henvisning til et af de to specialiserede centre. Frit sygehusvalg gælder — dit postnummer begrænser ikke adgangen.

services.en: Denmark's patient organisation (member of Danske Patienter). Telephone counselling open to all — members and non-members; legal counselling (rights at work, education, benefits) for members. Founded 1997.
services.da: Danmarks patientforening (medlem af Danske Patienter). Telefonrådgivning åben for alle — medlemmer såvel som ikke-medlemmer; juridisk rådgivning (rettigheder ift. arbejde, uddannelse, sociale ydelser) for medlemmer. Stiftet 1997.

en: Start with your GP: describe symptoms; first-line options are hormonal treatment and pain relief.
Mild/moderate disease → GP or gynecologist (private practice or hospital clinic) manages medical treatment.
Persistent pain despite treatment → your GP/gynecologist refers you to a gynaecological department.
Suspected deep or advanced endometriosis → referral to one of the two specialised centres (Rigshospitalet, East / AUH Skejby, West). Free hospital choice applies.
Newer options: Ryeqo (reimbursed, specialist prescription) or Yselty (out-of-pocket / enkelttilskud via region).
Contact Endometriose Fællesskabet for support and rights guidance at any point.
da: Start hos egen læge: beskriv symptomerne; førstelinje er hormonel behandling og smertelindring.
Let/moderat sygdom → egen læge eller gynækolog (privatpraksis eller hospitalsklinik) varetager medicinsk behandling.
Vedvarende smerter trods behandling → egen læge/gynækolog henviser til gynækologisk afdeling.
Mistanke om dyb eller fremskreden endometriose → henvisning til et af de to specialiserede centre (Rigshospitalet, øst / AUH Skejby, vest). Frit sygehusvalg gælder.
Nyere muligheder: Ryeqo (generelt tilskud, specialistrecept) eller Yselty (egenbetaling / enkelttilskud via regionen).
Kontakt Endometriose Fællesskabet for støtte og rettighedsvejledning — når som helst i forløbet.

region_note.en: Region is shown for orientation only — free hospital choice means your postcode does not restrict access to the specialised centres. Nearest specialised centre is shown by East/West split. Postcode → region follows the five official administrative regions (source: PostNord/region postcode maps; verified 2026-09-07).
region_note.da: Region vises kun som orientering — frit sygehusvalg betyder, at dit postnummer ikke begrænser adgangen til de specialiserede centre. Nærmeste specialiserede center vises ud fra øst/vest-opdelingen. Postnummer → region følger de fem administrative regioner (kilde: PostNord/regionernes postkort; verificeret 2026-09-07).

postcode.note: Standard 5-region postcode grouping; Greenland (39xx) and Faroe Islands not covered. Verify edge postcodes before relying.

access_note.en: NICE guidance TA1067 (2025) recommends linzagolix as an option for moderate-to-severe symptoms of endometriosis in England. Access via NHS specialist services — check local commissioning.
access_note.da: NICE-guideline TA1067 (2025) anbefaler linzagolix som mulighed ved moderate til svære endometriosesymptomer i England. Adgang via NHS-specialist — tjek lokal finansiering.

services.en: National charity. Free confidential helpline 0808 808 2227 (trained volunteers), nurse-led support line (NICE-based, bookable call-back), web chat, local support groups, online community.
services.da: National velgørenhed. Gratis fortrolig hotline 0808 808 2227 (trænede frivillige), sygeplejerske-støttelinje (NICE-baseret, bookbart opkald), webchat, lokale støttegrupper, online fællesskab.

en: Start with your GP; NICE guidance (NG73) covers diagnosis and management of endometriosis in the NHS.
Your GP can refer you to a gynaecology service; endometriosis specialist centres exist across the UK (NHS — BSGE-accredited centres).
Medication access and surgery follow NHS commissioning in your area; some treatments (e.g. linzagilix) follow NICE technology appraisal guidance.
Endometriosis UK offers support at every stage — helpline, nurse line, local groups.

services.en: Non-profit (501c3) focused on disease recognition, advocacy, expert surgical training and research funding. Education, doctor-finder resources, events.
services.da: Non-profit (501c3) med fokus på sygdomsanerkendelse, advocacy, kirurgisk uddannelse og forskningsfinansiering. Uddannelse, læge-finder-ressourcer, events.

services.en: Founded 1980, the world's first endometriosis organisation. International self-help network (66 countries), support, education and research. HQ Milwaukee, WI.
services.da: Grundlagt 1980, verdens første endometriose-organisation. International selv hjælps-netværk (66 lande), støtte, uddannelse og forskning. Hovedkvarter Milwaukee, WI.

en: Access depends on your insurance plan — start with your primary care provider or OB-GYN.
Endometriosis specialist surgeons are often found through patient organisations (EndoFound, Endometriosis Association) or professional directories.
Medication reimbursement varies by insurer and plan; the organisations above keep current education and resources.

services.en: Germany's largest and oldest self-help organisation (founded 1996, 4,500+ members). Nationwide free counselling — ~50 weekly appointments, phone or video; social-law counselling for members.
services.da: Tysklands største og ældste selv hjælps-organisation (grundlagt 1996, 4.500+ medlemmer). Landsdækkende gratis rådgivning — ~50 ugentlige samtaler, telefonisk eller video; socialretlig rådgivning for medlemmer.

en: Start with your Hausarzt or Frauenarzt (gynecologist); hormonal treatment and pain relief are first-line.
Germany has certified endometriosis centres (Endometriose-Zentren) — the Vereinigung keeps information on specialised care.
The Vereinigung offers free nationwide counselling by phone/video and can point you to local self-help groups.

name.en: MulherEndo – Associação Portuguesa de Apoio a Mulheres com Endometriose
name.da: MulherEndo – Associação Portuguesa de Apoio a Mulheres com Endometriose

services.en: Portuguese patient association (listed on endometriosis.org) that promotes physical and psychological support, rehabilitation and recovery for women with endometriosis through information and direct cooperation with patients; runs a national petition and advocacy for a national endometriosis strategy. Contact and membership via the website.
services.da: Portuguese patient association (listed on endometriosis.org) that promotes physical and psychological support, rehabilitation and recovery for women with endometriosis through information and direct cooperation with patients; runs a national petition and advocacy for a national endometriosis strategy. Contact and membership via the website.

en: Start with your GP (médico de família) or a gynaecologist through the public SNS or private care; ultrasound and referral to a gynaecology specialist are the usual next steps.
Several public hospitals run specialised endometriosis consultations — ask your gynaecologist for a referral to the nearest one.
MulherEndo is the national patient association for information, community and advocacy; contact via mulherendo.pt.

services.en: National non-profit patient association (founded 2002, Girona; registered with Spain's national associations register) that provides information about endometriosis and its treatments mainly through its website endoinfo.org and social media, and answers questions from affected women by email (info@endoinfo.org).
services.da: National non-profit patient association (founded 2002, Girona; registered with Spain's national associations register) that provides information about endometriosis and its treatments mainly through its website endoinfo.org and social media, and answers questions from affected women by email (info@endoinfo.org).

name.en: Asociación de Afectadas de Endometriosis de Madrid (ADAEM)
name.da: Asociación de Afectadas de Endometriosis de Madrid (ADAEM)

services.en: Madrid-based patient association (listed on endometriosis.org) supporting women affected by endometriosis: information, mutual support and awareness activities, with contact by phone and email (adaem@adaem.org.es).
services.da: Madrid-based patient association (listed on endometriosis.org) supporting women affected by endometriosis: information, mutual support and awareness activities, with contact by phone and email (adaem@adaem.org.es).

services.en: Catalan association (listed on endometriosis.org, Barcelona) working on endometriosis awareness, information and support for affected women in Catalonia; contact by email (endocatalunya@gmail.com).
services.da: Catalan association (listed on endometriosis.org, Barcelona) working on endometriosis awareness, information and support for affected women in Catalonia; contact by email (endocatalunya@gmail.com).

en: Start with your GP (médico de familia) or a gynaecologist; Spain's national endometriosis strategy guides referral to specialised endometriosis units in hospitals.

AEE (endoinfo.org) offers nationwide information and answers patient questions by email; regional associations such as ADAEM (Madrid) and Endometriosis Catalunya run local support and awareness activities.
For suspected severe or complex disease, ask for referral to a specialised endometriosis unit within the public health system (SNS) or a recognised private centre.

services.en: France's first national endometriosis association (created 2001; WEO member; approved by the French health ministry). Provides information, support, a helpline, local groups and advocacy to improve recognition and care of endometriosis.
services.da: France's first national endometriosis association (created 2001; WEO member; approved by the French health ministry). Provides information, support, a helpline, local groups and advocacy to improve recognition and care of endometriosis.

services.en: French national patient association (Paris, listed on endometriosis.org) that informs women about endometriosis and works on awareness, support and advocacy so the disease is better recognised; contact by email (contact@endomind.org).
services.da: French national patient association (Paris, listed on endometriosis.org) that informs women about endometriosis and works on awareness, support and advocacy so the disease is better recognised; contact by email (contact@endomind.org).

services.en: French association focused on information about endometriosis and on advocacy with policy makers for better recognition and care of the disease; active on its website and social media.
services.da: French association focused on information about endometriosis and on advocacy with policy makers for better recognition and care of the disease; active on its website and social media.

en: Start with your GP (médecin traitant) or a gynaecologist; France has a national endometriosis strategy and a network of specialised expert centres (filières) for complex cases.
EndoFrance (national helpline and local groups) and ENDOmind provide patient support and information; Info-Endométriose focuses on information and advocacy.
The Ministry of Health runs an endometriosis information portal; associations can point you to local support and specialised care.

services.en: National Italian patient association (listed on endometriosis.org; founded 2001) offering a toll-free helpline (800 031977), information and support for women with endometriosis; it also created the Fondazione Italiana Endometriosi to fund research.
services.da: National Italian patient association (listed on endometriosis.org; founded 2001) offering a toll-free helpline (800 031977), information and support for women with endometriosis; it also created the Fondazione Italiana Endometriosi to fund research.

services.en: National all-volunteer Italian patient association (Parma; listed on endometriosis.org; registered in the national RUNTS third-sector register) providing information, free support groups ('Non sei sola'), courses and awareness campaigns for people with endometriosis.
services.da: National all-volunteer Italian patient association (Parma; listed on endometriosis.org; registered in the national RUNTS third-sector register) providing information, free support groups ('Non sei sola'), courses and awareness campaigns for people with endometriosis.

en: Start with your GP (medico di base) or a gynaecologist (public SSN or private); endometriosis is officially recognised in Italy as a chronic, disabling disease, and many regions have diagnostic-therapeutic pathways (PDTA) and reference centres.
AIE runs a national toll-free helpline (800 031977) and information services; A.P.E. ODV offers free support groups and information across the country.
For complex disease, ask your gynaecologist for referral to a regional endometriosis reference centre.

services.en: German-speaking Swiss endometriosis association (listed on endometriosis.org and by the Stiftung Endometriose Forschung as Switzerland's central self-help organisation). Offers moderated self-help groups (online and local), practical guidance and information for people living with endometriosis.
services.da: German-speaking Swiss endometriosis association (listed on endometriosis.org and by the Stiftung Endometriose Forschung as Switzerland's central self-help organisation). Offers moderated self-help groups (online and local), practical guidance and information for people living with endometriosis.

services.en: French-speaking Swiss endometriosis association (Yvonand; listed on endometriosis.org) providing information, support and awareness for affected women in French-speaking Switzerland; contact by phone or email (laure@endosuisse.ch).
services.da: French-speaking Swiss endometriosis association (Yvonand; listed on endometriosis.org) providing information, support and awareness for affected women in French-speaking Switzerland; contact by phone or email (laure@endosuisse.ch).

en: Start with your GP (Hausarzt / médecin traitant) or gynaecologist; several Swiss hospitals run certified endometriosis centres for specialised diagnosis and surgery.
Endo-Help covers the German-speaking region with self-help groups and guidance; Groupe Endometriosis Suisse does the same for French-speaking Switzerland.
Note: the former endometriose.ch address now leads to the Inselspital (Bern) endometriosis centre — it is a hospital service, not a patient association.

services.en: Austrian national patient association (Vienna; listed on endometriosis.org and by the Stiftung Endometriose Forschung as the headquarters of Austria's self-help groups). Provides counselling and information by phone/email (office@eva-info.at) and coordinates endometriosis self-help groups across Austria.
services.da: Austrian national patient association (Vienna; listed on endometriosis.org and by the Stiftung Endometriose Forschung as the headquarters of Austria's self-help groups). Provides counselling and information by phone/email (office@eva-info.at) and coordinates endometriosis self-help groups across Austria.

en: Start with your GP (Hausarzt) or a gynaecologist (Frauenarzt); hormonal treatment and pain management are first-line options.
Austria has specialised endometriosis centres in several hospitals — ask for referral if symptoms are severe or complex.
EVA is the national self-help association: free counselling and information by phone/email, plus local self-help groups nationwide.

services.en: Dutch national patient organisation (WEO member; listed on endometriosis.org). Provides reliable information, a helpline, peer-support activities and advocacy for people with endometriosis; also runs the dedicated youth website (ongewoonongesteld.nl).
services.da: Dutch national patient organisation (WEO member; listed on endometriosis.org). Provides reliable information, a helpline, peer-support activities and advocacy for people with endometriosis; also runs the dedicated youth website (ongewoonongesteld.nl).

en: Start with your GP (huisarts), who can refer you to a gynaecologist; the Netherlands has specialised endometriosis centres in academic and top-clinical hospitals.
Endometriose Stichting offers information, a helpline and peer-support (lotgenoten) activities nationwide; its website also lists care-related resources.
For complex disease, ask your gynaecologist about referral to a specialised endometriosis centre.

services.en: National Belgian endometriosis association (Eksel; WEO member and listed on endometriosis.org). Provides information, support and awareness for people with endometriosis in Belgium, with contact by phone and email (info@endohome.be).
services.da: National Belgian endometriosis association (Eksel; WEO member and listed on endometriosis.org). Provides information, support and awareness for people with endometriosis in Belgium, with contact by phone and email (info@endohome.be).

services.en: Belgian (French-speaking) expert association whose goal is to make endometriosis visible and to inform, bring together and support women and girls affected; its website lists where to consult specialised practitioners (e.g. at Erasmus hospital Brussels).
services.da: Belgian (French-speaking) expert association whose goal is to make endometriosis visible and to inform, bring together and support women and girls affected; its website lists where to consult specialised practitioners (e.g. at Erasmus hospital Brussels).

en: Start with your GP (huisarts / médecin généraliste) or a gynaecologist; several Belgian hospitals have specialised endometriosis clinics.
EndoHome is the national association for information and support across the country; Toi Mon Endo (French-speaking) offers support and lists specialised consultation options.
For severe or complex disease, ask for referral to a hospital endometriosis centre.

services.en: National Irish patient charity (Dublin; WEO member and listed on endometriosis.org) providing information, support groups, a helpline and awareness for people with endometriosis; formerly at endo.ie, now at endometriosis.ie.
services.da: National Irish patient charity (Dublin; WEO member and listed on endometriosis.org) providing information, support groups, a helpline and awareness for people with endometriosis; formerly at endo.ie, now at endometriosis.ie.

en: Start with your GP; referral to a gynaecologist is available through the public HSE system or private care, and regional specialist endometriosis services exist.
The Endometriosis Association of Ireland provides information, a helpline and support groups nationwide — a good first point of contact for peer support.
Ask your gynaecologist about referral to a specialist endometriosis centre for complex or severe disease.

services.en: Non-profit endometriosis awareness campaign and the official Cyprus representative of the Worldwide EndoMarch movement (active for 11 consecutive years, per 2026 press). Runs yearly March awareness events, storytelling/art exhibitions and open online discussions with a specialist gynaecologist, under the auspices of the Cyprus Ministry of Health.
services.da: Non-profit endometriosis awareness campaign and the official Cyprus representative of the Worldwide EndoMarch movement (active for 11 consecutive years, per 2026 press). Runs yearly March awareness events, storytelling/art exhibitions and open online discussions with a specialist gynaecologist, under the auspices of the Cyprus Ministry of Health.

en: Start with your GP or a gynaecologist through the public health system (GESY) or private care; laparoscopic surgery by a specialist is the diagnostic gold standard for endometriosis.
Endometriosis care in Cyprus is mainly provided by gynaecologists and specialised private centres (e.g. the Endometriosis & Fertility Centre); ask your doctor for a specialist referral.
EndoMarch Cyprus runs annual awareness events and online sessions with specialists each March — a way to find information and community.

services.en: National patient association for people with endometriosis in Norway. Provides information, peer support and community, raises awareness, and offers a dedicated website section for young people with endometriosis.
services.da: National patient association for people with endometriosis in Norway. Provides information, peer support and community, raises awareness, and offers a dedicated website section for young people with endometriosis.

en: Start with your GP (fastlege), who can refer you to a gynaecologist or a hospital department with endometriosis expertise.
If symptoms suggest endometriosis, ask about referral to a specialised gynaecology unit or endometriosis centre in your health region.
Contact Endometrioseforeningen for information, peer support and guidance on navigating diagnosis and treatment in Norway.

services.en: National patient association for people with endometriosis in Sweden, with local associations across the country. Provides information, peer support, member meetings and advocacy to improve care and shorten time to diagnosis.
services.da: National patient association for people with endometriosis in Sweden, with local associations across the country. Provides information, peer support, member meetings and advocacy to improve care and shorten time to diagnosis.

en: Start with your GP or a gynaecology clinic (gynekologmottagning); Sweden has regional endometriosis teams and specialised centres (e.g. university hospitals) for complex cases.
Ask your care centre about referral to a specialist endometriosis unit if symptoms are severe or do not improve.
Contact Endometriosföreningen Sverige or your local association for peer support, information and guidance.

services.en: Finnish patient association for people with endometriosis. Provides information, peer support, member activities and awareness-raising about endometriosis in Finland.
services.da: Finnish patient association for people with endometriosis. Provides information, peer support, member activities and awareness-raising about endometriosis in Finland.

en: Start with your GP (terveysasema) or occupational health doctor, who can refer you to a gynaecologist (naistentautien erikoislääkäri).
For suspected or confirmed endometriosis, ask about referral to a hospital gynaecology unit with endometriosis expertise.
Contact Endometrioosiyhdistys ry for peer support and reliable information in Finnish.

services.en: Icelandic association for people with endometriosis, based in Reykjavik. Offers a members' peer-support group, educational talks, information days and open appointments (including in English), and raises awareness about endometriosis and adenomyosis.
services.da: Icelandic association for people with endometriosis, based in Reykjavik. Offers a members' peer-support group, educational talks, information days and open appointments (including in English), and raises awareness about endometriosis and adenomyosis.

en: Start with your GP (heimilislæknir), who can refer you to a gynaecologist (kvensjúkdómalæknir).
Specialised endometriosis care is provided at Landspitali University Hospital in Reykjavik; ask your doctor about referral there for complex cases.
Contact Endósamtökin (endo.is) for information, peer support and their member support group.

services.en: Poland's first endometriosis information portal, run by the Polish Endometriosis Association. Provides reliable information about the disease, diagnosis and treatment, and connects patients with support.
services.da: Poland's first endometriosis information portal, run by the Polish Endometriosis Association. Provides reliable information about the disease, diagnosis and treatment, and connects patients with support.

services.en: Polish foundation supporting women with endometriosis through regional peer-support groups, emotional support, education and awareness initiatives, and funding treatment support projects.
services.da: Polish foundation supporting women with endometriosis through regional peer-support groups, emotional support, education and awareness initiatives, and funding treatment support projects.

en: Start with your GP or gynaecologist (ginekolog); a referral is needed for specialist hospital care (poradnia ginekologiczna / oddział ginekologii).
Endometriosis care in Poland is delivered mainly through hospital gynaecology departments; seek out units or specialists with endometriosis experience for suspected deep disease.
Use endometrioza.org for information and support, or contact Fundacja Pokonać Endometriozę for regional peer-support groups.

services.en: The first Czech patient organisation focused on endometriosis, founded in 2021. Runs a support centre staffed by trained volunteers with endometriosis, provides information and peer support, raises awareness, and advocates for better care and more certified treatment centres.
services.da: The first Czech patient organisation focused on endometriosis, founded in 2021. Runs a support centre staffed by trained volunteers with endometriosis, provides information and peer support, raises awareness, and advocates for better care and more certified treatment centres.

en: Start with your GP (praktický lékař) or gynaecologist (gynekolog), who can refer you to hospital gynaecology care.
Ask about referral to a certified endometriosis centre (e.g. the centre at Podolí, Prague) for complex or deep endometriosis.
Contact EndoTalks for peer support, information and guidance through its support centre.

services.en: Hungarian public-benefit foundation supporting women with endometriosis, running the Endometriózis Magyarország platform. Provides reliable information, community and peer support via its Facebook group, awareness campaigns, and collaborates with doctors and specialists.
services.da: Hungarian public-benefit foundation supporting women with endometriosis, running the Endometriózis Magyarország platform. Provides reliable information, community and peer support via its Facebook group, awareness campaigns, and collaborates with doctors and specialists.

en: Start with your GP (háziorvos) or gynaecologist (nőgyógyász); hospital gynaecology departments provide specialist care.
For suspected endometriosis, seek out gynaecologists or hospital units with endometriosis experience, particularly for complex cases.
Contact the "Együtt könnyebb" Női Egészségért Alapítvány / Endometriózis Magyarország for reliable information and peer support.

services.en: Romanian patient association for people with endometriosis, based in Ploiești. Provides information and support for patients, runs awareness campaigns and school education projects, and produced the documentary Endodyssey about endometriosis.
services.da: Romanian patient association for people with endometriosis, based in Ploiești. Provides information and support for patients, runs awareness campaigns and school education projects, and produced the documentary Endodyssey about endometriosis.

en: Start with your GP (medic de familie) or gynaecologist (medic ginecolog); referral is needed for hospital specialist care.
Endometriosis surgery and complex care are concentrated in certain hospital gynaecology departments; ask about doctors with endometriosis experience.
Contact Asociația Eu și Endometrioza for information, peer support and awareness events.

services.en: Bulgarian foundation, based in Sofia, working on endometriosis and reproductive health. Provides information and raises awareness about endometriosis, its diagnosis and treatment, and offers support to affected women.
services.da: Bulgarian foundation, based in Sofia, working on endometriosis and reproductive health. Provides information and raises awareness about endometriosis, its diagnosis and treatment, and offers support to affected women.

en: Start with your GP (личен лекар), who can refer you to a gynaecologist (акушер-гинеколог).
For suspected endometriosis, seek a gynaecologist or hospital unit with endometriosis experience; complex surgery is available mainly in larger centres.
Contact the Endometriosis and Reproductive Health Foundation for information and support.

name.en: Udruga žena oboljelih od endometrioze "Ja sam 1 od 10"
name.da: Udruga žena oboljelih od endometrioze "Ja sam 1 od 10"

services.en: Croatian association of women with endometriosis, founded in 2022 in Zagreb from the "I am 1 in 10" citizens' initiative. Provides peer support and community, publishes expert Q&A and information, raises awareness, and advocates for better endometriosis care with health institutions and parliament.
services.da: Croatian association of women with endometriosis, founded in 2022 in Zagreb from the "I am 1 in 10" citizens' initiative. name.en: Komunitas Endometriosis Indonesia (Indonesian Endometriosis Community, IEC)
name.da: Komunitas Endometriosis Indonesia (Indonesian Endometriosis Community, IEC)

services.en: Patient-led community (est. 2015, 19,000+ active members) offering peer support, education, advocacy and events for women with endometriosis ('EndoSisters') in Indonesia; coordinates via Facebook, WhatsApp and Telegram.
services.da: Patient-led community (est. 2015, 19,000+ active members) offering peer support, education, advocacy and events for women with endometriosis ('EndoSisters') in Indonesia; coordinates via Facebook, WhatsApp and Telegram.

en: Care is delivered through public hospitals (RSUD/RSUP, often via BPJS Kesehatan national health insurance) and private hospitals/clinics — start with a dokter kandungan (gynaecologist).

Endometriosis centres exist at some teaching/referral hospitals (e.g. RSUP Fatmawati's endometriosis centre in Jakarta), which cooperate with the Indonesian Endometriosis Community for patient support.
Join Komunitas Endometriosis Indonesia / Yayasan Endometriosis Indonesia channels for education, peer support and community events.

services.en: National charity raising awareness, funding research and providing education and advocacy for the roughly one million Australians with endometriosis; runs workplace accreditation programs, events and research grants.
services.da: National charity raising awareness, funding research and providing education and advocacy for the roughly one million Australians with endometriosis; runs workplace accreditation programs, events and research grants.

services.en: Australian patient organisation offering free nationwide support: QENDOCare telehealth clinic (physiotherapy, counselling, dietetics, nursing), the 1800 ASK QENDO helpline, a mentoring program and volunteer-led local community groups.
services.da: Australian patient organisation offering free nationwide support: QENDOCare telehealth clinic (physiotherapy, counselling, dietetics, nursing), the 1800 ASK QENDO helpline, a mentoring program and volunteer-led local community groups.

services.en: National health-promotion charity (WEO member) providing education and resources on pelvic pain including endometriosis, with school and community education programs and a website of clinical and self-help information.
services.da: National health-promotion charity (WEO member) providing education and resources on pelvic pain including endometriosis, with school and community education programs and a website of clinical and self-help information.

en: Start with a GP; a referral is needed for Medicare-subsidised specialist (gynaecologist) care. Several states run public endometriosis and pelvic pain clinics that accept GP referrals.
Diagnosis typically involves ultrasound and specialist review; laparoscopic surgery by an excision specialist is performed in both public and private systems.
For support and navigation while waiting or between appointments, contact QENDO's helpline/telehealth, Endometriosis Australia, or PPFA's education resources.

services.en: National charity providing a free support line (0800 733277), education for schools and health professionals, advocacy and resources for people affected by endometriosis in New Zealand.
services.da: National charity providing a free support line (0800 733277), education for schools and health professionals, advocacy and resources for people affected by endometriosis in New Zealand.

services.en: Patient-led New Zealand charity (WEO member) raising awareness of endometriosis and providing peer support, community connection and advocacy for people with endometriosis across Aotearoa.
services.da: Patient-led New Zealand charity (WEO member) raising awareness of endometriosis and providing peer support, community connection and advocacy for people with endometriosis across Aotearoa.

services.en: Community-funded New Zealand charity (Hamilton) providing information, resources and individual support requests for people living with endometriosis, plus awareness and education activities.
services.da: Community-funded New Zealand charity (Hamilton) providing information, resources and individual support requests for people living with endometriosis, plus awareness and education activities.

en: Start with your GP; public gynaecology services are accessed by referral through the public health system (may involve waiting lists).
Private gynaecologists and endometriosis specialists are available for faster assessment at your own cost or via insurance.
Endometriosis New Zealand's support line (0800 733277) and Endo Warriors Aotearoa / Insight Endometriosis provide information and peer support at all stages.

services.en: Patient community and awareness organisation whose official Facebook page (10,000+ followers) raises awareness of endometriosis in the Philippines and connects patients; affiliated support groups offer peer discussion for patients and families.
services.da: Patient community and awareness organisation whose official Facebook page (10,000+ followers) raises awareness of endometriosis in the Philippines and connects patients; affiliated support groups offer peer discussion for patients and families.

en: See an obstetrician-gynaecologist at a public (DOH/LGU) hospital for subsidised care or at a private hospital/clinic; PhilHealth covers some hospital episodes.
Endometriosis is often managed by gynaecologists with laparoscopic surgery expertise in metro centres (e.g. Manila).
Join Endometriosis Philippines' Facebook page/groups for awareness material, doctor recommendations from peers and community support.

name.en: ESAF Sri Lanka (Endometriosis Support & Awareness Foundation)
name.da: ESAF Sri Lanka (Endometriosis Support & Awareness Foundation)

services.en: Foundation supporting people with endometriosis across Sri Lanka through awareness campaigns, advocacy for early diagnosis and community/peer support; active on Instagram (@esaf.srilanka) and states recognition as a member of the World Endometriosis Organization.
services.da: Foundation supporting people with endometriosis across Sri Lanka through awareness campaigns, advocacy for early diagnosis and community/peer support; active on Instagram (@esaf.srilanka) and states recognition as a member of the World Endometriosis Organization.

en: Gynaecology care is free through the public health system (Ministry of Health hospitals, via GP or OPD referral) or available privately at your own cost.
Laparoscopic surgery for endometriosis is performed at tertiary and teaching hospitals in Colombo and other major cities.
ESAF Sri Lanka provides awareness material and peer support; contact it via its website or Instagram to connect with the patient community.

services.en: Patient-support organisation raising awareness of endometriosis in Bangladesh and supporting patients; its official presence is a Facebook page and it is listed as a member of the World Endometriosis Organization (WEO). Bangladeshi doctors also organise national endometriosis conferences (e.g. Dhaka, 2024).
services.da: Patient-support organisation raising awareness of endometriosis in Bangladesh and supporting patients; its official presence is a Facebook page and it is listed as a member of the World Endometriosis Organization (WEO). Bangladeshi doctors also organise national endometriosis conferences (e.g. Dhaka, 2024).

en: Gynaecology care is available through public medical college hospitals (low cost, long waits) and private hospitals/clinics in Dhaka and other cities.
Ask for a gynaecologist experienced in laparoscopy for endometriosis; specialised endo care is concentrated in Dhaka.
Endometriosis Society Bangladesh's Facebook page is the main gateway to awareness material and patient community in Bangladesh.

services.en: NGO representing women living with endometriosis in the Maldives, running awareness campaigns and community support; member of the World Endometriosis Organization (WEO) and listed among active NGOs in the MV+ Community Impact Awards. Its former website is offline; it is currently active on X (@endomaldives).
services.da: NGO representing women living with endometriosis in the Maldives, running awareness campaigns and community support; member of the World Endometriosis Organization (WEO) and listed among active NGOs in the MV+ Community Impact Awards. Its former website is offline; it is currently active on X (@endomaldives).

en: Gynaecology services are available at public hospitals (e.g. Indira Gandhi Memorial Hospital, Malé) and private clinics; complex endometriosis surgery often requires referral abroad.
Seek a gynaecologist with laparoscopic skills for assessment and treatment planning.
Endometriosis Association of Maldives (X: @endomaldives) runs awareness and support activities for patients.
